name: Toolbox POD
tagline: Design custom shirts and hoodies, see mockups, and order prints
description: Official hosted MCP server from Toolbox POD, a print-on-demand shop in Utah. Create shirt and hoodie designs, show them on mockups in the colors you choose, price an order, prepare it with a checkout link, and follow it to tracking. Remote server with OAuth sign-in: after installing, authorize it from Cline's MCP menu. Ships to US addresses only.
